text.p: British coach John Toshack quit Spanish first division soccer club Deportivo Coruna on Sunday, club chairman Augusto Lendoiro said.
Toshack, long under fire from fans, was barracked during Sunday's 2-2 draw with Celta Vigo.
Lendoiro said Toshack had presented his resignation earlier in the week but that he had accepted it only after the Celta game.
Toshack has clashed frequently with Lendoiro, fans and players since he joined the Galician club in the 1995 close season.
Toshack, a former Welsh international striker who has coached in Spain for many years, will be replaced on a temporary basis by second team coach Jose Manuel Corral.
